Name: Stillframe
Description: Freeze an enemy for 3 seconds.

Name: Haste Loop
Description: Move at 1.5x speed for 6 s, then 0.5x for 3 s.

Name: Rewind
Description: Return your position and Body to 3 seconds ago. Libido stays spent.

Name: Stretched Second
Description: Everything near you moves at 25% speed, your throws too.

Name: Delay
Description: The enemy's next card resolves 4 seconds late.

Name: Glimpse
Description: See the enemy's next card for 5 seconds.

Name: Read the Hand
Description: Reveal 2 hidden enemy cards for the bout.

Name: Ghost Path
Description: Show the enemy's next attack path as a red line.

Name: Premonition
Description: Name a family. If the enemy plays it, it fizzles.

Name: Counter-Fate
Description: Pre-load a card that fires when you are next hit.

Name: Afterimage
Description: Your last attack repeats at 50% two seconds later.

Name: Reprise
Description: Replay the last card you used without spending it.

Name: Resonance
Description: Each consecutive hit on one target deals 15% more.

Name: Stolen Echo
Description: Replay the enemy's last card as yours at 60%.

Name: Long Echo
Description: Damage dealt this round repeats next round.

Name: Coin Toss
Description: Next hit: 50% double damage, 50% nothing.

Name: Loaded Die
Description: The next random effect goes your way.

Name: Jinx
Description: The enemy's next card has a 40% chance to fizzle.

Name: All In
Description: Spend all Libido. Deal twice what you spent.

Name: Second Draw
Description: Swap one Orbit card for a random Archive card.

Name: Decoy
Description: Spawn a fake you that draws attacks.

Name: False Card
Description: Throw a bluff disguised as any card.

Name: Fog of Self
Description: Become invisible for 4 seconds.

Name: Mirage Field
Description: Your last card appears three times; one is real.

Name: Nightmare
Description: The enemy sees you in place of their ally for 3 s.

Name: Strike
Description: A clean, heavy hit.

Name: Shockwave
Description: A ring that knocks everyone back.

Name: Pierce
Description: Passes straight through Ward cards.

Name: Charged Blow
Description: Grows stronger the longer you hold it.

Name: Shatter
Description: Destroy an active card effect on the field.

Name: Dash
Description: Blink 5 metres.

Name: Slow
Description: Target moves at 50% for 5 seconds.

Name: Tailwind
Description: Your throws fly faster and further this round.

Name: Frostbite Step
Description: A slowed target is hurt by every step.

Name: Whiplash
Description: Swap your speed with the enemy's for 5 s.

Name: Shield
Description: Block the next hit.

Name: Thorn Ward
Description: Block and return 30% of the damage.

Name: Bastion
Description: A dome: nothing in or out for 4 seconds.

Name: Absorb
Description: Block a hit and turn it into Libido.

Name: Last Stand
Description: Survive one lethal hit at 1 Body.

Name: Sting
Description: Poison that ticks for 6 seconds.

Name: Rot
Description: For 8 s the target's healing hurts instead.

Name: Numbing
Description: The target's next card costs 2 more.

Name: Spreading Blight
Description: Poison jumps to the nearest fighter on hit.

Name: Wither
Description: Cut the target's max Body by 10% this bout.

Name: Mark
Description: The marked target takes 20% more from all sources.

Name: Scent
Description: See a marked target through illusions.

Name: Snare
Description: A hidden trap roots whoever steps in for 3 s.

Name: Pursuit
Description: A spectral hound chases the marked target.

Name: Apex
Description: Triple damage on a marked target under 30% Body.

Name: Chain
Description: Tether an enemy within 2 metres of their spot.

Name: Shackle
Description: Lock one of the enemy's throwing hands.

Name: Link Lock
Description: Chain both enemies; parting over 4 m hurts both.

Name: Name Bind
Description: Speak the enemy's true name to stop them for 5 s.

Name: Gravebind
Description: A fallen ally cannot be revived next round.

Name: Wager
Description: Both stake 20 Body; the next hit takes the pot.

Name: Oath of Blood
Description: Take 10 now; your next 3 hits deal 50% more.

Name: Terms
Description: Ban an action. Breaking it costs the enemy 25.

Name: Ransom
Description: Lock an enemy card until they pay 4 Libido.

Name: Clause
Description: If you lose this round, the winner loses a card.

Name: Silence
Description: The enemy cannot play a card for 3 seconds.

Name: Card Lock
Description: Seal one visible Orbit card for 2 rounds.

Name: Null Zone
Description: An area where no card effects work.

Name: Dispel
Description: End one active enemy effect.

Name: Exile
Description: Remove one enemy card for the bout. Once per bout.

Name: Reflect
Description: Bounce the next thrown attack back.

Name: Mirror Step
Description: Copy the enemy's movement, flipped, for 6 s.

Name: Inversion
Description: The enemy's next buff becomes a debuff.

Name: Return to Sender
Description: Move every status on you to the enemy.

Description: Share your next damage with the enemy; take 25% more.

Name: Copy
Description: Copy the enemy's last card.

Name: Borrowed Form
Description: Take the enemy's stats for 6 seconds.

Name: Study
Description: After 3 enemy hits land, copy one for free.

Name: Steal
Description: Take one enemy card for the rest of the bout.

Name: Parrot
Description: Echo the enemy's shout to weaken their next card.

Name: Drain Touch
Description: Heal for 50% of the damage dealt.

Name: Blood Tether
Description: Drain 5 Body per second while within 3 m.

Name: Vampire Mark
Description: All your damage on the target heals you 25%.

Name: Feast
Description: Heal for all damage you dealt this round.

Name: Martyr's Draw
Description: Move Body between you and your partner.

Name: Sap
Description: Steal 2 Libido.

Name: Drain Field
Description: Enemies inside lose 1 Libido per second.

Name: Overload
Description: Their next card costs double; you get the extra.

Name: Burnout
Description: The enemy gains no Libido next round.

Name: Battery
Description: Store Libido in this card; release it at +50%.

Description: Split damage to you 50/50 with the enemy.

Description: Give one of your card effects to your partner.

Description: Under 25% Body, your partner deals 50% more.

Description: Break every link; each deals 10 to its owner.

Name: Proxy
Description: Take all damage meant for your partner for 5 s.

Description: Heal 15 Body.

Description: Heal 40 Body over 8 seconds.

Description: Remove every status on you.

Name: Steady
Description: Restore 30 Ego.

Description: Revive a fallen ally at 50%. Once per bout.

Name: Intimidate
Description: Push the enemy back 3 metres.

Name: Panic
Description: Shuffle the enemy's Orbit so they grab the wrong card.

Name: Haunt
Description: Add 20 to the enemy's Shadow.

Name: Paralysis
Description: The enemy cannot throw for 3 seconds.

Name: Despair
Description: Drain 40 Ego. At 0 the enemy is Possessed.
